trailhead.name: Forest Road 38 (Middle Fork Nooksack Road) road-end at the Rankin Creek switchbacks

identifiedBy.fact: standard SW face X couloir climbed from parking on NF-38 switchbacks (2nd switchback 2,650 ft), bikes to 6th switchback ~3,700 ft, then Rankin Creek valley; the route's own text also calls FR-38 the direct approach

otherFacts.value: FR-38 gate at milepost 9.9 open on that trip; parked 2nd switchback 2650 ft; 3rd switchback 2780 ft reachable by truck/SUV; 5th switchback 3420 ft by high-clearance
highest trees ~6000 ft above Rankin Creek
drove NF 38 to ~3100 ft near Rankin Creek in non-lifted SUV; steep trail up ridge just past last switchback ~3740 ft
Rankin Creek junction 2550 ft; logging road switchbacks to ~4100 ft

notes: Opened: countryhighpoints.com/lincoln-peak (X couloir from NF-38 switchbacks, Rankin Creek valley; strong, about this route), turns-all-year.com/trip-reports/lincoln-peak-x-couloir (NF 38 near Rankin Creek, route X couloir; Heliotrope named only as an alternative not taken), turns-all-year 2008 Black Buttes report (Rankin Creek junction; its Lincoln party implied Elbow Lake lot, weak, one comment), WTA Ridley Creek page (trailhead 48.7263,-121.9018 at FR 38 road end ~13 mi). Nothing opened names Heliotrope Ridge as the usual start for the SW face X couloir. NO placement given: the start is a point on the road (switchbacks near Rankin Creek, 2,650-3,700 ft), not the USFS/WTA Middle Fork Nooksack / Ridley Creek trailhead (48.7267,-121.9003 USFS; 48.7263,-121.9018 WTA), which is the road end and is not shown to be the same spot. Road closed by washout at milepost 7 since July 2026 per route text. Name signed only.

nothing new. Two searches, no page names a 'Boola Boola' buttress. Opened lemkeclimbs.com South Face 5.5 page (no trailhead stated, no mention of this route). Search summaries show Little Annapurna reached from Stuart Lake TH (Aasgard Pass), Ingalls Creek/Crystal Creek, or Snow Creek, so the peak has several starts and nothing ties this route to one.

nothing new. No page about a SW face found in two searches; the one Mountain Project 'Southwest Face' hit is Early Morning Spire (opened), not this peak. Peak has several starts in use: Dingford Creek (NW face, Cascade Climbers 2023 summary), Waptus Lake / Cooper Lake side (north ridge, SummitPost summary), Dutch Miller Gap (sibling). Not tied to one.

nothing new. Two searches returned only west ridge, south face, east ridge pages (Mountaineers, WTA, yellowleaf summaries; none opened for this face). No page about a northwest face. Commonwealth Basin / Alpental or PCT Snoqualmie North are the usual starts for the peak but nothing ties this face to one.

nothing new. Opened Mountain Project Middle Peak area (lists only East Face and Gunrunner; no approach text, no north face), stephabegg.com North Gunsight West Face (started Downey Creek Trailhead via Downey/Bachelor Creeks, ~12.8 mi day 1; says Stehekin side is the alternative; no Middle north face), AAJ Gunrunner (approach started at Blizzard-Gunsight Col, two-day approach, no trailhead named). Two starts in use for the range (Downey Creek from the west, Stehekin from the east); nothing ties this face to either.

otherFacts.value: 18 pitches, ~1500 ft, IV 5.10 A1 (Gunrunner traverse of NE, N, Middle, S peaks)

notes: nothing new. A traverse has no single start; no opened page names this 'Traverse Route'. AAJ Gunrunner report (likely the nearest traverse, not shown to be the same route) names no trailhead, only a two-day approach to Blizzard-Gunsight Col and Chickamin Glacier. See north face note.

identifiedBy.fact: Mix Up Peak area 'Getting There' (which lists PBS Late Night Special) says park in the Cascade Pass lot and take the Cascade Pass trail; peak-level, weak but the peak has one road access

otherFacts.value: unpaved Cascade River Road to circular lot under Johannesburg Mountain

notes: WEAK, peak-level. Opened: Mountain Project Mix Up Peak area (no route description; whole-peak getting-there = Cascade Pass lot), Wikipedia (peak ~1 mile south of Cascade Pass), WTA Cascade Pass (coordinates 48.4754,-121.0751; mentions Mixup on Ptarmigan Traverse). Mountaineers East Face page returned 403. No page about this route's own approach. Only road access for the peak is Cascade Pass; the Stehekin side is a long backcountry alternative.

nothing new. Opened turns-all-year Chaval west face (started from car on Illabot Road, unnamed spot, no north ridge), WTA 2001 report returned 403, SummitPost pages 403. Search summaries show two starts in use for Chaval: Illabot Creek road (west face/ramp) and Grade Creek road -> Bluff Lake -> Cliff Lake (a commenter says Grade Creek Road is no longer accessible); the 2017 north ridge attempt summary says a day push was too ambitious. Nothing ties the north ridge to one.
